title: ever EVIE|Short Sleeves A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Short Lace Sleeve Ruffled Sweetheart A-Line Midi Dress. Made from high-stretch fabric for a comfy fit, it flatters your shape with ease. The ruffled neckline and delicate lace sleeves add a romantic touch, while the flowing A-line skirt makes it perfect for weddings and special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
